> On Tue, May 09, 2023 at 04:02:31PM +0530, Ravulapati Vishnu Vardhan Rao wrote:

>>   	val = ucontrol->value.enumerated.item[0];
>> +	if (val < 0 && val > 15)
>> +		return -EINVAL;

> control, that way it can't geto out of sync.

Will address and resend it..

Thanks for review.
